lee: Heads-up: sampleapp (android) hit JSON parse errors while streaming on a flaky cafe WiFi. small fragments arrive split and occasionally out of order.

anya: which SDK and transport? any raw traces?

lee: android-sdk v0.9.2 using EventSource. raw: 
[2026-05-01T11:22:10.001Z] RECV: data: {"id":"sess-7","type":"chunk","payload":"{\"delta\":\"Start of mes"}\n\n"}
[2026-05-01T11:22:10.210Z] RECV: data: {"id":"sess-7","type":"chunk","payload":"sage continued\"}\n\n"}
[2026-05-01T11:22:10.213Z] PARSE_ERR: Unexpected token s in JSON at position 0

lee: The first payload is partial and parser attempts JSON.parse immediately. second fragment arrives later but we already errored.

priya: This matches other mobile reassembly issues. Server emits ordered events but TCP/IP can segment. JS sdk accumulates until the double newline delimiter and then parses. Android EventSource callbacks may deliver per-line. We need parity: incremental reassembly keyed by stream id.

anya: Also observed auth refresh reconnections causing dup ids and interleaving in another run. if reconnect replay doesn't respect last-event-id properly at the edge we can get overlap.

priya: Proposed actions: 1) add per-stream buffer in android-sdk, append fragments, emit only when we detect a complete JSON object (brace matching with string/escape handling). 2) add safeguards: max buffer size (256KB) and a short reassembly timeout (200-500ms) to avoid holding forever. 3) unit + integration tests that simulate segmentation, reordering, and last-event-id replay. 4) sampleapp defensive patch: try/catch parse and stash partials if parse fails.

lee: i'll add a small repro script that toggles the device network (adb) and records raw EventSource chunks.

anya: CI: dan suggested adding an integration harness that shuffles chunks and delays; we should add that to eng-ci. ci-bot: creating job task.

ci-bot: Job created: devx/reassembly-harness (#487).

priya: i'll take the android-sdk change, branch devx/android-reassembly. estimate ~2d. will include metrics: sdk.reassembly.count and sdk.reassembly.buffer_drops.

lee: temporary workaround for support: set sampleapp config "streaming.buffer_mode = "hold-partials"" and advise users to upgrade to the beta.

anya: also update docs: "Mobile SDKs must handle SSE fragmentation and reconnection replay" and troubleshooting steps.

priya: created ticket INF-1410 and linked this thread.

ci-bot: Ticket INF-1410 created: "android-sdk: incremental SSE reassembly + tests"

lee: thanks team, i'll upload logs and the adb repro when ready. :thumbsup:
